entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: GetValues rejects an array shorter than the row, unlike the IDataRecord contract #39352
  • Query: `The LINQ expression 'p' could not be translated` when `Any` predicate compares parameter with expression referencing parameter (e.g. `p => p == p.ToUpper()`) #39351

Closed

  • Sqlite: translate Math.Floor() #37440
  • Cosmos: The reading of a ResponseMessage is always done synchronously #34093
    11.0-preview5
  • Xamarin: huge performance hit when using RemoveRange and AddRange in EFCore 3.0 compared to EFCore 2.2.6 on different platforms #18887
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Support GROUPING SETS, ROLLUP and CUBE via EF.Functions in GroupBy key selectors #39362
    community-contribution
  • Update tests for Azure SQL #39360
  • Fix collection Contains normalization element type and overload matching (#39329) #39359
    community-contribution
  • [release/9.0]: Bump SQLitePCLRaw.core from 2.1.13 to 2.1.14 #39358
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump SQLitePCLRaw.bundle_e_sqlite3 from 2.1.13 to 2.1.14 #39357
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle from 2.4.0 to 2.6.1 #39356
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39355
  • Copy only what fits in SqliteDataReader.GetValues #39354
    community-contribution
  • Throw IndexOutOfRangeException from SqliteDataReader.GetOrdinal for an unknown name #39353
    community-contribution

Merged

  • Escape the LIKE escape character for char parameters in StartsWith/EndsWith/Contains #39316
    community-contribution
  • Fix GetOrdinal for duplicate column names and repeated case-insensitive lookups #39317
    community-contribution
  • Don’t scaffold string concatenation defaults as a single string literal #39318
    community-contribution
  • Use the invariant culture for small and unsigned integer literals in CSharpHelper #39319
    community-contribution
  • Print shifts and repeated block expressions correctly in ExpressionPrinter #39320
    community-contribution
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39361

Updated

  • Fix precompiled queries for sealed entity types #39326
    community-contribution
  • Fix migrations alter column with referenced index filter #39323
    community-contribution
  • Use SYSDATETIME and SYSUTCDATETIME with datetime2 colums #39321
    community-contribution
  • Preserve implicit conversions during query precompilation #39313
    area-harness
  • Fix connection cancellation notifications to interceptors #39293
  • feat: add per-query command timeout #39278
    community-contribution
  • Keep a SqliteDataReader usable after its command is disposed #39337
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Fix Azure SQL JSON_VALUE RETURNING over nested OPENJSON projections #39299
    Servicing-consider
  • Make parameter collection projections that cannot be materialized untranslatable so they get client eval #39349
    community-contribution
  • Translate grouping aggregates as window functions behind an opt-in #39240
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Use live version of System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs #39350
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39348
